question:
Alice, Bob, and Claire are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a grey present, Bob has a pink present, and Claire has a brown present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Bob and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. Finally, Alice and Claire swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Alice has the
Options:
(A) grey present
(B) pink present
(C) brown present
solution:
Each row lists present colors in order: Alice, Bob, Claire.
Initial: grey, pink, brown
1. Bob ↔ Alice: pink, grey, brown
2. Alice ↔ Claire: brown, grey, pink
3. Alice ↔ Claire: pink, grey, brown
Alice has the pink present, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
